summary: Arqit Quantum Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 annual general meeting held September 8, 2026. Holders of 9,421,171 ordinary shares as of the August 13, 2026 record date were represented, constituting a quorum. Shareholders approved all proposals, including electing Carlo Calabria (9,169,365 for, 171,501 against) and Andrew Leaver (9,233,348 for, 106,557 against) as directors serving until the 2029 AGM. This is a routine meeting-results filing, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors, or risk-arb angle apply.
